methods_quotes.q: 95% CIs were computed using normal approximation for standard errors for proportions.
Incidence was calculated using the following equation: (cases/population) x 100,000 persons.
Population estimates were calculated using data from the U.S. Census Bureau.
Analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute).
